blocks.title: 1. What Is an Angle?
blocks.content:
An angle measures a **turn** between two lines that meet.

• Measured in **degrees (°)**
• A full circle is **360°**

blocks.title: 2. The Angle Family
blocks.content:
• **Acute (< 90°):** Small and sharp.
• **Right (90°):** Perfect L-shape [ ∟ ].
• **Obtuse (> 90°):** Wide and open.
• **Straight (180°):** A flat line.

blocks.title: 3. Angle Rules
blocks.content:
**1. Angles on a straight line = 180°**
*(If one is 110°, the other is 70°)*

**2. Vertically opposite angles are equal**
*(When lines cross, opposite angles match)*

blocks.title: 4. Example
blocks.content:
Two angles sit on a straight line. One is **135°**.

**Step 1:** Straight line = 180°
**Step 2:** 180° - 135° = 45°

**Answer:** **45°**

blocks.title: 5. Pitfalls
blocks.content:
Don't confuse a **straight line (180°)** with a **full circle (360°)**!

Check if the angles sit on a line or go all the way around a point.
